articles.title: A Secret Hidden for 20 Years Lets You Play as a Wampa in Star Wars Game!
articles.summary: A new easter egg in the 2005 game Star Wars: Battlefront 2 lets you play as a Wampa on Endor. Just name your profile 'Wampa' and hunt Ewoks as the big furry creature!

articles.title: Digging Into the Great Wall Unearths a Giant Cannon and Ancient Secrets!
articles.summary: Archaeologists restoring a section of the Great Wall of China found a 247-pound cannon from 1632, plus bricks with secret messages and turquoise treasures. The wall reveals how soldiers lived and traded long ago.

articles.title: Zoom! Swimmers Smash Records in Fastest 50-Meter Butterfly Race Ever
articles.summary: At the European Championships, Egor Kornev swam the 50-meter butterfly in 22.36 seconds, almost breaking the world record. Seven swimmers set national records in the fastest semi-final in history!
